name: gsd
description: The default cycle run by the GSD (get-shit-done) flow system. Classification and shipping are harness steps before and after it; system.steps lists the steps GSD owns. GSD itself is linked, not shipped: it must be installed for each runtime that runs these steps. To add a step between GSD steps, copy this flow into an own flow with harness flow copy gsd <new-name>.

system.name: GSD (get-shit-done)
system.install: npx @opengsd/gsd-core@latest (installs GSD for each runtime it supports; run it once per runtime that runs a GSD step)
